scope: Independent read-only final source/provenance review of native-origin durability and sealed original-workspace relocation
outcome: No blocking defect found in the reviewed implementation and actual evidence paths.

review.subject: First registration
review.conclusion: Registration unconditionally hashes and statically replays the actual operational log before either writing or reusing a receipt. The caller cannot supply registration time or native-write binding. Existing origins are compared immutably, excluding only the newly generated candidate timestamp.

review.subject: First closure
review.conclusion: Actual close retains verify-post-3a and splice verification, then explicitly requires a present bound original log and exact replay for each registered origin before writing the closure. A previous frozen receipt cannot bypass that unconditional live-log branch. The closure policy remains optional when verifying older receipts, preserving historical closure paths.

review.subject: Absent operational log after closure
review.conclusion: Absence invokes the exact version-3 closed dependency-ordered receipt with native-origin freeze policy, matching run, closure time after origin registration, and actual successful canonical autopilot tool-step3-close result with all coverage and completion after closure. Raw origin, raw baseline, original source/manifest/contract/capture/result/prompt pins are checked directly; source projections, original immutable author authentication, original metadata capture interval and baseline/home checks still run. No recursive full closure verification or invented native execution is introduced.

review.subject: Present operational log
review.conclusion: A present local operational log remains subject to its original raw hash and full restricted static reconstruction even when a frozen closure exists. The closure deliberately pins retained source evidence rather than copying or adding transcripts to scoped artifacts.

review.subject: Relocated clone
review.conclusion: The only new absolute-path fallback is Step 3 and requires the exact sealed native origin and immutable result/prompt markers. Original prompt and log paths must end in the canonical retained relative names with the same original directory prefix, and the bound actual result must contain those exact paths. Ordinary immutable attempt filename, run/role/label, terminal completion, exit status, local regular-file/realpath and dispatched prompt header checks remain active. No general path rewrite or unsealed fallback was added.

review.subject: Original evidence and current owner maintenance
review.conclusion: The original native source and six carrier projections remain distinct from current owner-repaired carriers. The actual archived contract is legitimately version 1 without optional run/batch fields; authenticated capture paths bind those identities. Current repair evidence must supply the complete attributed raw-source chain ending at current content, six current hashes and actual completed owner review. Execution-credit and mathematical-acceptance flags remain false; ordinary certification and later review/gates are still required.

limitations: This is static source and actual stored-evidence review, not new native execution, mathematical acceptance, or a claim that the future transcript-free clone path has been executed. Canonical native tool-result identity uses the existing engine-owned result convention.
